verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only one-off scheduling: a single broadcast can be scheduled to send at a set time (`send_at`), which is not a recurring schedule. The pack also lists 'Unlimited Visual Automations' and 'RSS campaigns', but no evidence states that either runs on a recurring time-based schedule, so none of these count toward recurring jobs or workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
